clue.text: German, height short, taken in by cunning swiftly

indicators.note: something taken in by a thing ends up inside it, so the first pieces sit within the next word

parts.note: wily means cunning; it is opened up to take the rest
G is the standard abbreviation for German
HT is the shortened form of height

explanation.surface: A cunning German, rather short, is quickly swallowed up by something.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer is a Spenserian archaism found in Chambers, the dictionary Azed solvers rely on; 'height short' is the standard abbreviation, not a deletion.
explanation.definitionFit: Wightly is an archaic Spenserian adverb meaning nimbly or quickly, matching swiftly.

clue.text: Jock's dripping round cracked shop lavabo

indicators.note: the Scots word goes round the outside of the other letters

parts.note: wat is the Scots word for wet, so a Scotsman's dripping

indicators.note: something cracked is broken up, so the letters of shop are rearranged

explanation.surface: A Scotsman describes a dripping washbasin in a shop that has a crack in it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cracked' rearranges SHOP into SHPO, and 'round' puts WAT (Scots for wet) around it.
explanation.definitionFit: A lavabo is a washbasin, and a washpot is an old word for a vessel used for washing in.

clue.text: Model in ladies, taken short uncomfortably

explanation.walkthrough: 'taken short' cuts LADIES to LADIE, and 'uncomfortably' rearranges those five letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A model is a perfect example to copy, and so is an ideal: the two nouns are synonyms.

clue.text: Italian imperialist? He's half taken in by taunt over succession

the letter is placed inside the word for taunt

a line is a succession, as in a line of kings

explanation.walkthrough: 'He's half' gives H (half of HE); 'taken in by' puts it inside GIBE (taunt) to make GHIBE, and 'over' sets that above LINE.
explanation.definitionFit: The Ghibellines were the medieval Italian faction that supported the Holy Roman Emperor against the Pope.

clue.text: In core of battlers tyro mishandled explosive

tyro's letters reshuffled

clue.text: Swear endlessly when entering toilet like a water expanse

clue.text: Unkempt heavy-metal fan repenting, reborn in part

clue.text: '——!' — a tub explodes? i.e. boat caught at sea (notoriously)

these four letters are taken out of the jumble

explanation.definitionFit: The blank stands for the exclamation itself, a colloquial 'got you!' crowing at a capture.

clue.text: Prodigal at one time taking strong drink in bit of broken pot

wine as the biblical strong drink

clue.text: Threw a wobbly? This may help to dispel glacial conditions

clue.text: One caught in downpour, not so unobtrusive
